review_improvement: Changes an insecure module dump into an exhaustive, identity-bound and timestamp-aligned OAM_1 static-data comparison.
independent_technical_reasoning: Adjacent OAMs may report the same model and firmware, so values alone do not prove which module was queried. Resource identity, stable serial/location fields and a synchronized Web module selection must be linked. Complete handling of null/extra properties also detects schema drift that a visual spot-check misses.
